register: Casual; the formal equivalents are が and けれども.

examples.gloss: It is expensive, but I will buy it.

examples.japanese: 行きたいけど時間がない。
examples.reading: いきたいけどじかんがない。
examples.gloss: I want to go, but I have no time.

examples.japanese: 学生だけど働いている。
examples.reading: がくせいだけどはたらいている。
examples.gloss: I am a student, but I work.

usage: But, although: 高いけど買う.
Often just softens a statement or request: すみませんけど, ちょっといいですか。
It can trail off at the end of a sentence: 行きたいけど…, leaving the rest unsaid.
It is casual. The formal forms are が and けれども.

compare.difference: のに complains or shows surprise. けど is a neutral contrast.
から gives the cause. けど sets up a contrast.
